name: prometheus.exporter.snowflake

arguments.name: account_name
arguments.description: The account to collect metrics from.

arguments.name: username
arguments.description: The username for the user used when querying metrics.

arguments.name: warehouse
arguments.description: The warehouse to use when querying metrics.

arguments.name: enable_tracing
arguments.description: Whether to have the snowflake database driver provide trace logging.

arguments.name: exclude_deleted_tables
arguments.description: Whether to exclude deleted tables when querying table storage metrics.

arguments.name: password
arguments.description: The password for the user used when querying metrics (required for password authentication).

arguments.name: private_key_password
arguments.description: The password for the user’s RSA private key (required for encrypted RSA key-pair authentication).

arguments.name: private_key_path
arguments.description: The path to the user’s RSA private key file (required for RSA key-pair authentication).

arguments.name: role
arguments.description: The role to use when querying metrics.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
